title: workspace config
description: Settings of the workspace module: publish-safety limits, the git lock, the plans migrator and the optional links plans/ and tasks/ in a checkout. All but `link_folders` are machine-wide: a project file cannot set them.

publish.description: Limits of publish-safety (what may enter the workspace git).

max_tracked_bytes.description: Files larger than this many bytes stay local-only (not in git).

max_binary_tracked_bytes.description: Binary files larger than this many bytes stay local-only (not in git).

lock_timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for the workspace git lock before WORKSPACE_GIT_LOCKED.

plans_migrator.description: Id of the bridge that fills the plans-migrator extension point.

link_folders.description: Link plans/ and tasks/ in the checkout to the folders of the project in the workspace (symbolic links listed in .git/info/exclude), so an IDE sees them. `workspace project attach|add` and `workspace sync` keep the links of a project while this is true; `workspace project link|unlink` set it for one project (projects/<code>/local/config.toml).
